A person, team, or account mark — image if you have one, initials if you don't.

```jsx
<Avatar name="Dana Okafor" size="md" />
<Avatar name="Dana Okafor" src="/assets/players/okafor.jpg" size="lg" status="live" />
```

Sizes: `xs` 20 (inline in text), `sm` 24 (dense rows), `md` 32 (default, list rows),
`lg` 44 (headers), `xl` 64 (profile). `status` adds a corner dot — only use it where
availability actually matters (Bench lineups), never decoratively.
